verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares does link the cap table to data-room documents inside its own platform. The story, though, requires an agent to pull the cap table programmatically, and nothing in the evidence shows a public API, an OpenAPI spec, or any agent-accessible interface. The OpenAPI, llms.txt and markdown-docs probes all returned 404. The only exports shown are ASC 718 Excel reports and scenario exports, plus a Gusto sync, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
